bio.summary: Jan Eggum is a Norwegian singer-songwriter from Bergen, often described as a leading voice of the Norwegian visetradisjon (folk-ballad tradition) and a face of musical melancholy. He debuted on CBS Norway in 1975 and broke through with the 1977 album Heksedans, going on to release more than fifteen studio albums sung largely in Bergen dialect. He is also a member of the Norwegian supergroup Gitarkameratene alongside Halvdan Sivertsen, Lillebjørn Nilsen and Øystein Sunde.
